feed_subtitle: AI-analyzed positions from Bundesagentur für Arbeit tailored to your CV.
feature_ba_direct_desc: Direct integration with the official Arbeitsagentur REST API ensures real-time access to thousands of verified job vacancies across Germany.
feature_cv_parsing_desc: Upload your CV in PDF, DOCX, or plain text. Our AI extracts your professional competencies, career history, and skills automatically.
feature_cefr_alignment_desc: Multi-factor matching evaluates German language proficiency (A2–C1), job type (Full-time, Part-time, Minijob), and your personal career goals.
feature_automation_desc: Background APScheduler pipelines query, deduplicate, and rank fresh vacancies at 06:00 and 18:00 every day without manual effort.
feature_deduplication_desc: Composite SHA-256 fingerprinting removes repetitive postings and recruiter spam before AI scoring for a clean job feed.
feature_multilingual_desc: Full native interface and AI match rationale support in German, English, Ukrainian, and Russian.

reset_choices_desc: Resets your job type, location, and language filters back to default values, and clears previous CV analysis history.
delete_account_desc: Permanently delete your account, saved preferences, uploaded CVs, and all matching history. This action cannot be undone (GDPR compliant).
